digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters - value maps and boundary guards
propositions: Two identical copies of _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE dict exist in adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py and adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py, creating maintenance risk and potential for undetected divergence between Cloud and DC deployments.
The existing one-literal guards for STATUS and PRIORITY maps in test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py prevent duplication of those maps but have no equivalent guard for the TICKET-TYPE map.

The ticket-type map must be relocated to a single canonical location in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py alongside the already-unified STATUS and PRIORITY maps, following the J2 pattern used for those maps.

Both Cloud and DC create paths must import the canonical ticket-type map under the historical private alias _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE using absolute imports to maintain compatibility with spec_from_file_location test loading.

An external consumer in test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py reads _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute on outbound_fields, requiring the alias binding strategy to preserve module-level attribute resolution.

The boundary guard must be extended to cover the ticket-type map so that a future third copy fails the build, and the guard must be mutation-tested by deliberately reintroducing a duplicate literal to verify RED/GREEN verdicts.
